text:
maria: Quick sync: were doing a region-staggered rollout for r-2026.03.22b. Target flag `llm_route_v2`. Plan: 0% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% across US/EU/APAC slices over ~45m. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. pinging @sre and @qa :spiral_calendar:

kevin: ack. Ill watch incident comms and page if anything trips. Whos capturing baselines?

tarun: Ill pin canary routing to `model-llm-v2.4-quant-lite` on canary+warm pools. Fallback is `model-llm-v2.2-stable`. Pins before any traffic shift.

maria: Explicit rollback/abort criteria (agreed):
- sustained 5xx rate >= 1.0% for >= 3 minutes
- p95 latency > 1.8x baseline for >= 8 minutes
- p99 latency increase > 300ms sustained for 5 minutes
- automated QA eval drop >= 5% absolute on smoke suite
If any trigger: set `llm_route_v2` -> 0% immediately, pin routing back to `model-llm-v2.2-stable`, and notify #eng-oncall.

qa-bot: QA will run smoke-suite at each ramp step (10/30/60). Posting pass/fail + diffs here.

sre-bot: Creating temp monitors: p95, p99, 5xx rate, token-cost-index. Alerts -> #eng-oncall and @kevin. Monitor links to follow.

deploy-bot: INFO: queued flag change `llm_route_v2` for r-2026.03.22b by maria. Will execute scheduled ramp and post step updates.

maria: Runbook synopsis:
1) 03:05 UTC - pin canary to `model-llm-v2.4-quant-lite` on canary+warm pools
2) 03:12 UTC - ramp to 10% (region-sliced cohorts)
3) 03:22 UTC - telemetry + QA smoke check
4) 03:30 UTC - ramp to 30%
5) 03:40 UTC - check, then 60% at ~03:50 UTC
6) 04:00 UTC - finish to 100% and remove pins by 04:10 if green

Tarun: Fast mitigation snippets (rwdctl):
```
# emergency: drop traffic to 0%
rwdctl flags set llm_route_v2 --percent 0 --reason "emergency"

# partial: reduce to 20% while leaving canary pinned
rwdctl flags set llm_route_v2 --percent 20 --cohort us-west
```

kevin: Im on watch 03:10-04:15. I'll escalate non-clear alerts.

sre-bot: UPDATE: monitors created. Baselines: p95 125ms, p99 340ms, 5xx 0.09%, token-cost-index 1.0. Alerts: https://ops.redwood/alerts/73821 (p95), https://ops.redwood/alerts/73822 (5xx)

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:06 UTC - canary pin applied to canary-1 and warm-2.

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:13 UTC - ramped `llm_route_v2` to 10% across regions.

qa-bot: 03:15 UTC smoke PASS. minor conversational diff -1.6%, within tolerance.

kevin: 03:18 UTC telemetry: p95 140ms, p99 360ms, 5xx 0.15%, cost index 1.02. All good relative to thresholds.

sre-bot: NOTE: suppressing noisy non-actionable alerts during ramp; breaches still notify.

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:31 UTC - ramped to 30%.

qa-bot: 03:33 UTC smoke PASS. one case flagged for human review but delta <2%.

kevin: 03:36 UTC saw p99 spike to 420ms for ~90s on EU shard; p95 steady. Investigating logs.

sre-bot: 03:38 UTC performed rolling restart on EU-x group to mitigate GC-induced tail latency. p99 recovering. Not breaching rollback thresholds.

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:51 UTC - ramped to 60%.

qa-bot: 03:53 UTC smoke PASS. no eval drops >=5%.

kevin: 03:58 UTC warm check: p95 142ms, p99 300ms, 5xx 0.11%. All within safety bounds. No holds.

deploy-bot: ACTION 04:06 UTC - ramped to 100% and marking rollout complete.

maria: Removing pins at 04:10 UTC and publishing release notes. Excerpt: "r-2026.03.22b: staged regional rollout to llm-v2.4-quant-lite; monitored p95/p99/5xx/cost; rollback criteria and rwdctl quick-ops included."

sre-bot: NOTE: temp monitors will auto-expire in 4h. Extend if you want longer retention.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: regional staged rollout finished. For emergency rollback: tag `@deploy-bot rollback llm_route_v2` or run rwdctl. Ping me for step logs and cohort slices.
